- **Approved REQs with no code tag (unimplemented):** the 14 M7 REQs — REQ-AUTH-004/005 (M7-010), REQ-KEY-007/008 (M7-020), REQ-KEY-009 (M7-030), REQ-SYS-007/008/011 (M7-040), REQ-SYS-009/010 (M7-050), REQ-OPS-009 (M7-060), REQ-TOOL-011/012/013 (M7-070). Expected — implementation not started; M8/M9 remain placeholders.

These are the tool/build REQs exercised manually or by running CI rather than by a `verifies:` unit test — TOOL-001/002 (status/checkin subcommands, driven live), BUILD-002 (CI, self-verifying on each run), BUILD-004 (`./dev`, a developer convenience). Their behavior is covered by the M1–M4 live gates.
- **Orphan tags (naming a nonexistent REQ):** none.
- **Broken architecture anchors:** none.
- **`done/` steps with empty `evidence.commits` (hygiene):** the M1 steps (STEP-M1-030..110, squashed `M1 complete` history) and STEP-M2-040/045/050 (commits f3f125f / 374ab55 / f99bb72, known from the M2 gate but not yet backfilled into the step files). All M3–M6 steps carry their SHAs. Non-blocking — code/test evidence is present and green.
- **Deliberately open acceptance criteria:** none outstanding for M1–M6 (the five M6 doc/firmware conflicts are all RESOLVED with live-recorded values and regression-pinned tests). The new M7 REQs carry their decomposition probes as open criteria by design: REQ-KEY-008 import type support (dead 70-byte cap), REQ-KEY-009 derive determinism + exact-scope routing, REQ-OPS-009 wrap HKDF info string / alignment / unwrap response shape, REQ-SYS-007 latency + any-scope, REQ-SYS-008 attended-manual shutdown (may stay open indefinitely), REQ-SYS-009/010/011 PPA-EPA determination + the storage uninitialized-`sub` firmware bug outcome.
